claim: Farm, Orchard and Foresters' Hub workers prepare every marked field or plot before they plant any of them, so marking a big farm at once delays the first harvest.
notes: Matches the game data: the Farm, Greenhouse, Orchard, Foresters' Hub and Oasis each have a BuildSiteBuilderBehaviour listing their field and tree build sites, so a marked plot is a build site their workers build. A villager's ActivityWorkOnBuilderWorkplace (working a build site) has importance 0.91, above ActivityWorkOnWorkplace (workplace work such as planting) at 0.90; only ActivityExtractResource (harvesting) ranks higher at 0.92.
